verdict.rationale: Adyen’s docs mention testing error-handling by forcing verification-check failures and describe live authorization/relayed-authorization flows, but there’s no direct evidence of a sandbox that lets developers simulate the full lifecycle (authorizations, clearings, reversals, refunds, declines) end-to-end. Missing for 10: explicit sandbox test-card scenarios for clearings, reversals, and refunds, and confirmation that declines/authorizations can be fully simulated without a real card swipe.
